summary: This class by Mark Levy discusses Parasha Tetro and the prohibition of jealousy. The speaker explains that Hashem is the conductor of our lives, giving each person what they need, and encourages listeners to focus on playing their own part rather than envying others.
questions: Why is jealousy considered a bad thing?
How does jealousy relate to Hashem?
What causes anxiety and depression according to the class?
What should you do the next time you feel jealous?
